name: Finch Remote MCP Server
summary: Finch's hosted MCP server for discovering and invoking third-party AI agents listed on the Finch agent marketplace, authorized with OAuth.
description: Endpoint publishes RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata with agent_market scopes (discover, buyer invoke/purchase, merchant). A Claude Code plugin and the Finch CLI (`@finchtech/cli`) are also offered. Submitted via the listing-request queue.
